notes.title: The first update
notes.content:
The first huge update is just about ready, it is currently being beta tested by a group of people. 

What the update adds :

Animations of foes appearing
 Black Jack
Difficulty slider
Detailed Foes
Fog Colours
Full-screen Option
New classes !
New foes
Row formation,
Updated Battle HUD and many more things have been added.
Updated Character Gen
Updated Overall U.I + Graphics of everything, 


Sorry for the lack of annocuments in the past few weeks, been very busy work wise in terms of adding things into the game.

notes.title: Update progress 0.01
notes.content:
A huge list of features is being added for the next update.

Exit game function for main menu (why this wasn't built into the engine by default is confusing) 
Game-play extras
Jumping updated....
Kill count even...
Rare foes!!
Repel/Increase spawn items


Most likely more will be added, but just wanted to let everyone know. That the game is being worked on and an update will come out in the near future. 

Till next time

dragon1up studios
